title: dockrillia striolata subsp. banksii
intro: Dockrillia striolata subsp. banksii, commonly known as the Banks' Dockrillia, is a species of orchid in the family Apocynaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of these constituents on human health.
